track: AI & Modern Data Apps with IBM Db2

submission_summary.title: Production-Grade AI Citizen Grievance Portal Powered by IBM Db2 & LangChain
submission_summary.description: An enterprise-ready civic grievance redressal portal combining high-contrast accessible UI, automated LangChain AI triage, natural language Db2 SQL generation, ward hotspot clustering, and real-time SLA breach analytics using native IBM Db2 date arithmetic.

native_db2_features_used: Continuous calendar date arithmetic: DAYS(CURRENT DATE) - DAYS(DATE(created_at)) > 15 for SLA breach identification
Native row limitation syntax: FETCH FIRST <N> ROWS ONLY (Db2 SQL standard)
Catalog inspection via SYSCAT.COLUMNS for zero-downtime startup schema reflection and migration
Table reorganizations via SYSPROC.ADMIN_CMD('REORG TABLE grievances') avoiding REORG PENDING (SQL0668N)
Native Db2 Stored Procedure SP_ESCALATE_OVERDUE executing in-engine SLA calculations and priority elevation
Native Db2 Kernel Trigger TRG_AUDIT_STATUS_CHANGE executing in-engine AFTER UPDATE audit logging into grievance_updates
ACID transactional audit history logging in grievance_updates with cascade referential integrity
ibm_db2_integration_depth.seed_dataset: 75 realistic civic grievances across 18 Delhi NCT municipal wards with seed history, AI triage metadata, and SLA breach timelines
ibm_db2_integration_depth.reproducibility: 1-command reproducibility via `docker compose up --build -d` without manual schema preparation

capabilities: Automated AI Triage on POST /api/grievances extracting normalized category, priority, and 1-sentence summary
'Ask the Data' NL-to-SQL Engine on POST /api/ask translating English questions into IBM Db2 SQL
Deterministic multi-tier security guardrails (SELECT-only whitelist, table restrictions, no DDL/DML, FETCH FIRST 50 ROWS ONLY)
Ward hotspot and potential duplicate complaint clustering in IBM Db2
Advanced Analytics Dashboard on GET /api/analytics with SLA monitoring and departmental performance charts
Officer Redressal Console & LangChain AI Action Drafter generating structured administrative action orders, inspection notices, and compliance directives
Interactive GIS Ward Hotspot Command Map (Leaflet.js) aggregating open dockets by ward with dynamic CircleMarkers and 1-click drilldown
Agentic Tool-Calling CPGRAMS Sahayak Assistant (POST /api/sahayak/chat) autonomously dispatching tool_track_docket, tool_ward_status, and tool_civic_knowledge on IBM Db2
